{{Documentation}}

This template creates a checklist. It relies on the gadgets [[MediaWiki:Gadget-checkboxList.js]] and [[MediaWiki:Gadget-checkboxList.css]].

==Usage==
Checklists may be used when the player needs to complete a series of tasks.

Do not use checklists if the list requires more than one column, such [[Achievement Diary]]. These tables should use the standard <code>lighttable</code> class.

* The first unnamed parameter is required and only takes unordered lists, created with an asterisk (<code>*</code>).
* The <code>title</code> parameter is optional and allows you to add a heading to the checklist.
* The <code>notoggleparent</code> parameter is optional and stops the parent checkbox being toggled when all the children are checked.
* The <code>smallindent</code> parameter is optional and reduces the indentation size of each nested level of checkboxes. An example of a smaller indentation can be seen in [[Template:Quest details]].

==Example==
<pre>{{Checklist|title=Example heading|
* Use a window on the nearby pillar.
* Put a mirror in the pillar giving out the light, and reflect the light north.
* Walk north to the next pillar. Add a mirror and reflect the light west.
* Go west, add a mirror, and reflect the light south.
* Go south to the next pillar. Use your yellow crystal on it to dye the light yellow.
}}</pre>

Produces:

{{Checklist|title=Example heading|
* Use a window on the nearby pillar.
* Put a mirror in the pillar giving out the light, and reflect the light north.
* Walk north to the next pillar. Add a mirror and reflect the light west.
* Go west, add a mirror, and reflect the light south.
* Go south to the next pillar. Use your yellow crystal on it to dye the light yellow.
}}
